svg.desc: Wadi Jazan Resort LOCATION Jazan City, KSA CLIENT Ministry of Water and Electricity, KSA COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2015 330 million SAR DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Electrical Engineering Mechanical Engineering Project Overview Inspired by Jazan's natural beauty, its lush landscapes, waterfalls, and beaches, this project delivers a fully integrated design and execution solution for the Ministry of Water & Electricity. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings and tender documents. The multidisciplinary services covered urban planning & design, landscape design, architectural design, electrical engineering and mechanical engineering.
